item.text:
**3B.9 Research Note**

Overall read: Lula’s 2024 domestic-crisis response was mostly protective and restraint-oriented. The strongest positive evidence is the Yanomami emergency response, Indigenous land and council actions, school-violence reporting, and tighter police-use rules. The main caveat is that police violence and some security deployments remained serious, so the record is not clean.

- [Lula says those who financed, planned, and executed the coup attempt should be punished](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/brazil-to-mark-anniversary-of-january-8-attack-on-democracy-3269163) — Reuters via Investing.com — 2024-01-08  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula responded to the January 8 domestic crisis by calling for punishment of the perpetrators rather than endorsing mob retaliation or collective punishment. That is the clearest positive evidence for a restrained crisis response.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.9; also 3B.1, 2B.9

- [Casa Civil apresenta medidas implementadas na Terra Yanomami à Corte Interamericana de Direitos Humanos](https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/maio/casa-civil-apresenta-medidas-implementadas-na-terra-yanomami-a-corte-interamericana-de-direitos-humanos/) — Casa Civil — 2024-05-23  
  - Claim-level summary: after the Yanomami humanitarian emergency, the government presented remediation measures to the Inter-American Court, showing a crisis response centered on protection and institutional repair rather than denial or spectacle.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.9; also 3B.7

- [Presidente Lula reafirma compromisso com homologações de Terras Indígenas e convoca Força-Tarefa](https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/04/presidente-lula-reafirma-compromisso-com-homologacoes-de-terras-indigenas-e-convoca-forca-tarefa) — Ministério dos Povos Indígenas — 2024-04-26  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula met with Indigenous leaders and ordered a multi-ministry task force on land homologations. This is evidence of responding to a vulnerable-group crisis through institutional action and de-escalation, not repression.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.9; also 3B.7, 3B.8

- [Conselho Nacional de Política Indigenista é reaberto com cerimônia de posse no Palácio da Justiça](https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/04/conselho-nacional-de-politica-indigenista-e-reaberto-com-cerimonia-de-posse-no-palacio-da-justica) — Ministério dos Povos Indígenas — 2024-04-16  
  - Claim-level summary: the government reopened the National Council of Indigenous Policy and restored a formal participation venue for Indigenous communities. That is a protective response to conflict and neglect, not a coercive one.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.9; also 3B.7, 3B.8

- [Decreto nº 12.341, de 23 de dezembro de 2024](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12341.htm) — Presidência da República / Planalto — 2024-12-23  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula regulated police use of force and less-lethal tools with explicit legality, precaution, necessity, due process, and non-discrimination language. In crisis terms, this is a restraint-first response to domestic violence risk.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.9; also 3B.6, 3B.5, 3B.4, 3B.1

- [Decreto que atualiza regras sobre o uso diferenciado da força pelas polícias é publicado](https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/decreto-que-atualiza-regras-sobre-o-uso-diferenciado-da-forca-pelas-policias-e-publicado) — Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública — 2024-12-24  
  - Claim-level summary: the justice ministry described the police-force reform as professionalization-oriented and rights-respecting, which supports a reading of suppression of violence rather than fear or retaliation.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.9; also 3B.6, 3B.5, 3B.4, 3B.1

- [Decreto nº 12.006, de 24 de abril de 2024](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12006.htm) — Presidência da República / Planalto — 2024-04-24  
  - Claim-level summary: school-violence reporting was integrated into national security information channels and an emergency number. That is a targeted crisis-response measure for children and school communities rather than a broad coercive crackdown.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.9; also 3B.7, 3B.6, 3B.5

- [GLO em portos e aeroportos é prorrogada pelo presidente Lula por 30 dias](https://www.gov.br/portos-e-aeroportos/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/05/glo-em-portos-e-aeroportos-e-prorrogada-pelo-presidente-lula-por-30-dias) — Ministério de Portos e Aeroportos — 2024-05-06  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula extended a GLO deployment in coordination with civilian authorities, and the description emphasizes inspections, seizures, and coordinated security. This is a bounded response to a security flare-up, though it is the closest item here to militarized spectacle.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.9; also 3B.6, 3B.5

- [Brazil: Comply with Rulings on Police Violence](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/15/brazil-comply-rulings-police-violence) — Human Rights Watch — 2024-03-15  
  - Claim-level summary: HRW reported lethal raids, intimidation, threats, and unlawful force by police, especially in low-income and Black communities. This is the main counterevidence: even where Lula’s formal response was restrained, state violence remained active on the ground.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.9; also 3B.7, 3B.6, 3B.5, 3B.4, 3B.1

- [World Report 2025: Brazil](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/brazil) — Human Rights Watch — 2025-01-01, covering 2024 events  
  - Claim-level summary: HRW said police killings and prison abuse continued through 2024, showing that government crisis management did not fully suppress underlying violence.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.9; also 3B.7, 3B.6, 3B.5, 3B.4, 3B.1

Search gap: I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Lula personally used domestic crises to incite retaliation, censor dissent, or impose collective punishment. The main negative evidence is indirect: continued police abuse and the need for bounded security deployments, not a clear pattern of deliberate crisis exploitation.
